licensing: The clone mirrors the LAYOUT of a real, live company's marketing site but contains only original placeholder material for a fictional brand ('Lattice'): original copy, original SVG artwork, and OFL fonts (Outfit as a substitute for the original's commercial face, IBM Plex Mono). Generators must never reproduce or fabricate: real company logos/wordmarks (including the original site owner's), real customers' or partners' marks, real people's photos or likenesses, real review scores/badges, the original site's copy, its URLs/endpoints, or its commercial fonts. In generated mode only generation-safe roles may be used; reference-only roles name the clone's own fictional brand and entities and are for reconstruction only.

brand.wordmark.description: the clone's fictional 'Lattice' wordmark (nav 139x32, footer 147x34). Identifies the source brand: never reused in generated pages.

brand.placeholder-mark.description: neutral text-style wordmark block for the generated page's own (fictional or user) brand, same box sizes as brand.wordmark.

brand.user-supplied-mark.description: a mark the requesting user supplies for their own brand.

customer.logo.description: fictional customer wordmarks of the clone (marquee 120 wide, story logos 130x100 box, slider 100x50 box, quote band max 112 wide).

customer.placeholder-logo.description: grey (#99a1af) wordmark rectangle with an invented company name; keep the source box sizes and height variety.

partner.lockup.description: co-brand lockups of the clone (news-band pill 326x71, 'powered by' 275x56).

partner.placeholder-lockup.description: neutral rounded pill with two short grey wordmark blocks.

platform.logo.description: fictional data-platform marks (integration tiles 30x30 in 40x40, stats tiles 30x30 in 48x48).

product.screenshot.description: original placeholder mockups of the fictional Lattice product UI (heroes, feature panels, tab media).

product.generated-visual.description: a new UI mockup or abstract product visual in the site palette (ink neutrals, purple #632ff5, orange #fe6703); must not depict any real product.

illustration.diagram.description: clone diagrams (pipeline DAG 555x409, lifecycle loops 1224x600, layered platform diagram 832x468).

illustration.generated-diagram.description: new neutral diagram: white node cards, #e5e7eb borders, connector lines; generic tiles instead of any logos.

illustration.abstract.description: abstract soft purple/orange gradient shape (mega-menu featured thumbnail 124x61).

photo.composite-scene.description: the clone's abstract gradient 'photo' compositions (T3 heroes, image cards, checklist split images).

photo.generated-scene.description: a new abstract or illustrated scene; any people shown must be fictional/illustrative, never a real person's likeness.

video.poster.description: 16:9 poster stand-ins with a play glyph (no third-party player is embedded).

video.placeholder-poster.description: neutral 16:9 poster with a centred play glyph; never embed a third-party player.

resource.generated-thumbnail.description: new 16:9 gradient or abstract thumbnail; no co-branding.

award.badge.description: fictional review/award badges and security seals in the stats bento.

rating.placeholder.description: clearly placeholder rating/award badge (e.g. 'Sample badge'); never a real review platform's mark or a real score.

icon.feature.description: generic line icons (feature cards 32/56px, mega-menu 20px in 40px tiles, IDE tiles 40px, 'why' icons 56px). Generic glyphs, safe to redraw.

person.fictional-avatar.description: illustrated or generated avatar of a fictional person (not used by the clone; available for generated testimonials).

person.real-photo.description: photo or likeness of a real, identifiable person. Forbidden in every mode: the clone contains none.

thirdparty.real-mark.description: any real company's logo/wordmark (the original site's owner, its real customers, real data platforms, review sites). Forbidden in every mode.

store.badge.description: app-store / marketplace marks. The clone has none; forbidden in every mode.

link.clone-route.description: the clone's internal routes (routes/routes.json). Routes whose slug names the source brand or its fictional entities are source identity.

link.placeholder.description: relative paths with no source names, '#', or absolute URLs on reserved .example / .invalid domains only.

link.source-external.description: the original live site's domains, docs/forum/status hosts, social profiles, form/submission endpoints and store links.

copy.clone-placeholder.description: the clone's own Lattice placeholder copy (src/content*). Fingerprinted in schema/source-copy-fingerprints.json.

copy.original.description: newly written copy within each field's maxWords/maxChars budget.

copy.source-site.description: the live original site's marketing copy. Never present in this project (CLONE_SPEC records lengths only) and forbidden in every mode.
